# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_RSI_DIVERGENCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price is above VWAP with a bullish EMA ribbon (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55) but RSI shows bearish divergence (price makes a higher high while RSI makes a lower high over the last three swing highs), the upward momentum is weakening and a mean-reversion short is favorable. This edge exists because the RSI divergence signals exhaustion of buying pressure despite the price being above VWAP and the EMA ribbon being bullish, indicating a potential short-term top.

## Mechanism

Entry rule:  
- Define bullish ribbon as EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 on the 5-min chart.  
- Require price > VWAP.  
- Compute RSI(14) on the same chart; detect bearish divergence when price makes a higher high while RSI makes a lower high over the last three swing highs.  
- Enter short at the first close below VWAP after the divergence is confirmed, provided the close is also below the EMA21.  
Exit shape:  
- Stop at the most recent swing high (prior to entry) or 0.5% above entry, whichever is tighter.  
- Take profit at 1× ATR(5) below entry.  
- With a runner that trails 20% of HWM after 1× ATR profit.
